ProjectCreateInput.name: ProjectCreateInput
ProjectCreateInput.description: Input for creating a new project. A name and at least one team are required. All other fields are optional and will use defaults if not specified.

ProjectUpdateInput.name: ProjectUpdateInput
ProjectUpdateInput.description: Input for updating an existing project. All fields are optional; only provided fields will be updated. Setting a field to null (where supported) will clear the value.

ProjectMilestoneCreateInput.name: ProjectMilestoneCreateInput
ProjectMilestoneCreateInput.description: Input for creating a new project milestone.

ProjectMilestoneUpdateInput.name: ProjectMilestoneUpdateInput
ProjectMilestoneUpdateInput.description: Input for updating an existing project milestone.

IssueCreateInput.name: IssueCreateInput
IssueCreateInput.description: Input for creating a new issue. At minimum, a team must be specified. A title is required unless a template is provided. All other fields are optional and will use defaults from the team or template if not specified.

IssueUpdateInput.name: IssueUpdateInput
IssueUpdateInput.description: Input for updating an existing issue. All fields are optional; only provided fields will be updated. Setting a field to null (where supported) will clear the value.

IssueRelationCreateInput.name: IssueRelationCreateInput
IssueRelationCreateInput.description: Input for creating a new issue relation between two issues. Both the source issue and related issue must be specified along with the relationship type.

IssueRelationType.name: IssueRelationType
IssueRelationType.description: The type of the issue relation.

CommentCreateInput.name: CommentCreateInput
CommentCreateInput.description: Input for creating a new comment.

AttachmentCreateInput.name: AttachmentCreateInput
AttachmentCreateInput.description: Input for creating a new issue attachment.

WorkflowState.name: WorkflowState
WorkflowState.description: A state in a team's workflow, representing an issue status such as Triage, Backlog, Todo, In Progress, In Review, Done, or Canceled. Each team has its own set of workflow states that define the progression of issues through the team's process. Workflow states have a type that categorizes them (triage, backlog, unstarted, started, completed, canceled), a position that determines their display order, and a color for visual identification. States can be inherited from parent teams to sub-teams.

IssueLabel.name: IssueLabel
IssueLabel.description: Labels that can be associated with issues. Labels help categorize and filter issues across a workspace. They can be workspace-level (shared across all teams) or team-scoped. Labels have a color for visual identification and can be organized hierarchically into groups, where a parent label acts as a group containing child labels. Labels may also be inherited from parent teams to sub-teams.

Issue.name: Issue
Issue.description: An issue is the core work item in Linear. Issues belong to a team, have a workflow status, can be assigned to users, carry a priority level, and can be organized into projects and cycles. Issues support sub-issues (parent-child hierarchy up to 10 levels deep), labels, due dates, estimates, and SLA tracking. They can also be linked to other issues via relations, attached to releases, and tracked through their full history of changes.

Project.name: Project
Project.description: A project is a collection of issues working toward a shared goal. Projects have start and target dates, milestones, status tracking, and progress metrics. They can span multiple teams and be grouped under initiatives.

ProjectMilestone.name: ProjectMilestone
ProjectMilestone.description: A milestone within a project. Milestones break a project into phases or target checkpoints, each with its own target date and set of issues. Issues can be assigned to a milestone to track progress toward that checkpoint.
